title: Verify MX messages are enabled for Inward SWIFT transfer before test execution

testDescription: This test validates the stated precondition that MX messages are enabled for inward SWIFT transfers by logging into TCS BANCS, accessing the Messages screen, and confirming that MX messages for incoming SWIFT can be viewed. stepsToPerform:

2) Login to TCS BANCS application using a valid BO user. Outcome: Login should be successful.
3) Navigate to Service Indicator >> Messages. Outcome: Land on messages screen.
4) On Messages screen, verify messages can be viewed. Outcome: Messages screen loads without error.
5) Verify that MX message received for incoming SWIFT is visible (using a known historical message). Outcome: MX message should be received.
6) From the main navigation, select Payments List from Credit transfer menu. Outcome: Land on Payments list.
7) Confirm Payments List renders successfully. Outcome: Payments List is displayed as expected.
8) Conclude environment readiness based on visibility of MX message and reachable screens. Outcome: MX messages are confirmed enabled for inward SWIFT.

- The Messages screen is accessible in TCS BANCS.
- At least one MX message for incoming SWIFT is visible, evidencing enablement.
- Payments List is accessible, confirming core BO navigation is operational.
- The documented precondition is satisfied prior to further test execution.
